exposure: Maternal b-blocker exposure (bisoprolol, propranolol, atenolol, metoprolol, nadolol)
cohort: The study included 306 consecutive pregnancies (267 women) with heart disease admitted to the hospital between January 2014 and October 2020.
finding: Carvedilol administration during pregnancy was associated with an increased incidence of neonatal hypoglycemia, while b-blocker administration was associated with a higher frequency of small for gestational age (SGA).
